programme.title: Masti
programme.desc: Three henpecked friends tired of their respective marriage decide to spice up their lives by indulging in an extramarital affair. But things go downhill very quickly when they become the prime suspects in a deadly murder case.

programme.title: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programme.desc: A group of Indian POW (Prisoners of War) from the 1971 Indo-Pak war rebels against the Pakistani army and tries to escape from their captivity. Helping the group in the mission is Gaurav, the son of a former Army Major also held captive by the enemy.

programme.title: Thodi Thodi Si Manmaaniyan
programme.desc: An obedient middle-class boy battles between wanting to pursue a career in rock music and his mother's dream of studying abroad. In the midst of a dilemma he learns an unsettling truth about his dead father which nearly jeopardises his life.

programme.title: Disco Dancer
programme.desc: Anil, a street performer with a tragic childhood, becomes India’s finest disco dancer. Tragedy strikes when he loses his mother in a staged accident. Now, he must not only fight his past demons but also confront the man determined to ruin his life.

programme.title: Jaanwar
programme.desc: A perilous criminal Sultan raises an orphan, who also grows up to become a criminal, known as Badshah. Badshah changes his ways after he falls in love with a street performer Sapna, but Sultan returns to remind Sultan of his past.

programme.title: Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega
programme.desc: Prakash marries the daughter of a rich businessman but his father-in-law disapproves of him. For his approval, Prakash plans his wife’s fake kidnapping and her eventual rescue. But the plan goes awry when some real kidnappers enter the picture.

programme.title: Jab We Met
programme.desc: The life of a suicidal industrialist takes a sharp turn when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train journey in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.

programme.title: Raja Hindustani
programme.desc: A young taxi driver and a rich city girl fall head over heels in love with each other. Defying her family, she marries him and relocates to his village. But her family weaves a web of deception to split them apart.
